claim: Vedānta 字面义'吠陀之终结'，原指奥义书；又称 Uttara-Mīmāṃsā；六派（āstika）定位。
locator: Wikipedia Vedanta：'The word Vedanta literally means the end of the Vedas and originally referred to the Upanishads.'；'also known as Uttara Mīmāṃsā, is one of the six orthodox (āstika) schools of Hindu philosophy and textual exegesis'；'It is also called Uttara Mīmāṃsā, which means the "latter enquiry" or "higher enquiry"; and is often contrasted with Pūrva Mīmāṃsā, the "former enquiry"'
note: '前—后弥曼差'称谓史由 I03 包承载，本包只引用定位。

claim: 吠檀多实为注释传统群而非单一学说（IEP 总括句）。
locator: IEP Advaita Vedanta：'Vedānta is nominally a school of Indian philosophy, although in reality it is a label for any hermeneutics that attempts to provide a consistent interpretation of the philosophy of the Upaniṣads or, more formally, the canonical summary of the Upaniṣads, Bādarāyaņa's Brahma Sūtra.'
note: 本包范围设定的直接依据。

claim: 三始（prasthānatrayī）=奥义书+梵经+薄伽梵歌；多传统各自解释同一组文本。
locator: Wikipedia Vedanta：'Vedanta developed into many traditions, all of which give their specific interpretations of a common group of texts called the Prasthānatrayī, translated as "the three sources": the Upanishads, the Brahma Sutras, and the Bhagavad Gita.'；SEP Śaṅkara：'The corresponding texts of the Upaniṣads, Bhagavadgītā, and Brahmasūtras constitute Advaita Vedānta's triple canon (prasthānatrayī).'
note: S1 的表述在'不二论的三重正典'名下。

claim: 三始的名目：Śruti prasthāna / Nyaya-Yukti prasthāna / Smṛti prasthāna。
locator: Wikipedia Vedanta：'The Upanishads, or Śruti prasthāna; considered the Sruti, the "heard" (and repeated) foundation of Vedanta. The Brahma Sūtras, or Nyaya prasthāna / Yukti prasthāna... The Bhagavadgītā, or Smriti prasthāna...'

claim: 《梵经》署名跋达罗衍那（亦称毗耶娑'编整者'）；555句四章；成书年代学。
locator: Wikipedia Brahma Sutras：'The text is attributed to the sage Bādarāyaṇa, who is also called Vyāsa (arranger), but is probably an accumulation of incremental additions and changes by various authors to an earlier work, completed in its surviving form in approx. 400–450 CE.'；'The oldest version may have been composed between 500 BCE and 200 BCE, with 200 BCE being the most likely date.'；'The Brahma Sūtras consist of 555 aphoristic verses (sutras) in four chapters, dealing with attaining knowledge of Brahman.'
uncertainty: 成书过程（递增而成）为学界判断；SEP 传承口径另作 'ca. first century BCE'（见 /school/overview/6）。

claim: 《梵经》以基于不一不异的综合整编奥义书诸说；批判数论二元论。
locator: Wikipedia Brahma Sutras：'a Sanskrit text which criticizes the metaphysical dualism of the influential Samkhya philosophy, and instead synthesizes and harmonizes divergent Upanishadic ideas and practices about the essence of existence, postulating Brahman as the only origin and essence of everything'；Wikipedia Vedanta：'The Brahma Sūtras of Badarayana serve as a bhedabheda-based synthesis of the teachings found in the diverse Upanishads'

claim: SEP 传承口径：不二论者经 Bādarāyaṇa（约前1世纪）上溯。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'Advaita Vedāntins trace their lineage back through Bādarāyaṇa (ca. first century BCE), who authored the Brahmasūtras (The Aphorisms on Brahman), to the individuals in Upaniṣadic narratives'
note: 与维基年代学不一致，两口径并陈不裁决。
uncertainty: 系传承追溯口径，非独立纪年。

claim: 诸吠檀多师皆作三注；注释竞争是学派存在方式。
locator: Wikipedia Vedanta：'All prominent Vedantic teachers, including Shankara, Bhaskara, Ramanuja, Madhva, Nimbarka, and Vallabha, wrote commentaries on these three sources.'；Wikipedia Brahma Sutras：'the most well studied commentaries on the Brahma Sūtras include the bhashya by Adi Shankara, those by the Vaishnava exegetes Srinivasa, Ramanuja, Madhvacharya, Bhaskara, Baladeva Vidyabhushan, Ramanandacharya, and that by the only Shaiva exegete, Srikantha Sivacharya'

claim: 《梵经》被各亚派各自解读。
locator: Wikipedia Brahma Sutras：'It has been influential to various schools of Indian philosophies, but interpreted differently by the non-dualistic Shiva Advaita and Advaita Vedanta sub-schools, and the Vaishnava theistic Vishishtadvaita and Dvaita Vedanta sub-schools, as well as others.'

claim: GRETIL 收《梵经》梵语明文本；首经 athāto brahmajijñāsā 可核。
locator: GRETIL 明文本标题'Bādarāyaṇa: Brahmasūtra'；正文首行：'athāto brahmajijñāsā | bbs_1,1.1 |janmādyasya yataḥ | bbs_1,1.2 |śāstrayonitvāt | bbs_1,1.3 |tat tu samanvayāt | bbs_1,1.4'；头部：'Publisher: Göttingen Register of Electronic Texts in Indian Languages (GRETIL), SUB Göttingen'；'THE TEXT IS NOT PROOF-READ!'
note: 原典层核读限于首四经与文本存在性；经义经二手引述层。
uncertainty: 文本自带未校对声明。

claim: 共同问题：梵与我之探究；通则与二元论例外条款。
locator: Wikipedia Vedanta：'Despite their differences, all traditions of Vedanta share some common features: Vedanta is the investigation of Brahman and Ātman.'；'The exception is that Dvaita Vedanta does not hold Brahman to be the material cause, but only the efficient cause.'

claim: 不二论：ātman 纯非意向性意识、数上同一于 brahman。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'The fundamental thrust of Advaita Vedānta is that the ātman is pure non-intentional consciousness. It is one without a second, nondual, infinite existence, and numerically identical with brahman.'
note: 此为不二论命题，非全派共识——cihai'梵我一如'与 review.md 已声明。

claim: 限定不二论：命我与梵相异、差异永不消解；信爱之道。
locator: Wikipedia Vedanta：'Vishishtadvaita, propounded by Ramanuja (11–12th century), asserts that Jīvatman (human souls) and Brahman (as Vishnu) are different, a difference that is never transcended.'；Wikipedia Ramanuja：'Ramanuja presented the epistemic and soteriological importance of bhakti, or the devotion to a personal God (Vishnu in Ramanuja's case) as a means to spiritual liberation.'

claim: 二元论：我与梵为完全相异的两种实在、我依于梵永不同一；解脱唯赖神恩。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya：'Madhvacharya's teachings are built on the premise that there is a fundamental difference between Atman (individual soul, self) and the Brahman (ultimate reality, God Vishnu), these are two different unchanging realities, with individual soul dependent on Brahman, never identical.'；'Liberation, asserted Madhva, is achievable only through the grace of God.'；Wikipedia Vedanta：'Atman (soul) and Brahman (as Vishnu) are understood as two completely different entities.'

claim: māyāvādin 是论敌贬称；商羯罗少用 māyā；幻论归属不二论而非全吠檀多。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'His philosophical adversaries pejoratively labeled him a māyāvādin—"one who argues the world is illusory (māyā)". While this epithet is not exactly incorrect, it misrepresents his intention as centered on world negation, and ignores the fact that he infrequently uses the term "māyā"'
note: IEP 侧证 māyā 的不二论形上学定位：'Brahman—the ultimate, transcendent and immanent God of the latter Vedas—appears as the world because of its creative energy (māyā).'

claim: 罗摩奴阇对商羯罗的四个主要异议与'选择性解读'指控。
locator: Wikipedia Ramanuja：'Ramanuja argued that Shankara's interpretation of the Upanishads had serious errors. He had four major objections: Brahman was differentiated consciousness and not undifferentiated consciousness. Shankara's concept of Nirguna Brahman was wrong and untenable. Beginningless karma, and not superimposition, was the cause of avidya. Sankara's doctrine of Avidya (Ignorance) and Maya (Illusion) has seven major flaws and inconsistencies.'；'He asserted, in his Sri Bhāshya, that purvapaksin (previous schools) selectively interpret those Upanishadic passages that support their monistic interpretation, and ignore those passages that support the pluralism interpretation.'
uncertainty: 四异议与'七缺陷'为该页概括层。

claim: 无明之争引出不二论内部争论与对立传统批评（罗摩奴阇/摩陀婆）。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'Such questions have caused several intra-Advaita debates as well as philosophical critiques from rival traditions such as Rāmānuja's Viśiṣṭādvaita Vedānta and Mādhva's Dvaita Vedānta.'
note: 引语三层级：内部分争（intra-Advaita）与外部批评（rival traditions）分明。

claim: 学派史轮廓：乔荼波陀（6或7世纪）→商羯罗（约8世纪，最早现存完整注释，托名问题）→罗摩奴阇→摩陀婆。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'He composed our earliest complete extant commentaries on the Brahmasūtras, Bhagavadgītā, and the ten principal Upaniṣads'；'There are hundreds of other texts attributed to Śaṅkara, but their authorship is questionable and most were likely composed in later centuries by monastic heads who held a "Śaṅkarācārya" title.'；Wikipedia Vedanta 学派小节年代（Gaudapada 7th/Shankara 9th/Ramanuja 11–12th/Madhvacharya 13th）
note: 商羯罗年代 SEP（8世纪）与维基（9世纪）不一致，并陈。
uncertainty: 托名著作真伪为学界判断。

claim: 新吠檀多与维韦卡南达西传；King 批评'统一吠檀多'叙事。
locator: Wikipedia Vedanta：'A major proponent in the popularization of this Universalist and Perennialist interpretation of Advaita Vedanta was Vivekananda, who played a major role in the revival of Hinduism. He was also instrumental in the spread of Advaita Vedanta to the West via the Vedanta Society, the international arm of the Ramakrishna Order.'；'This was contra-factual as, historically, Hinduism and Vedanta had always accepted a diversity of traditions.'；IEP：'there are many saints and philosophers whose tradition is rooted primarily or largely in Advaita philosophy. Prominent among the saints are Bhagavan Ramana Maharśi, Swami Vivekananda, Swami Tapovanam, Swami Chinmayānandā...'
note: 维韦卡南达未核读专页，不系生卒。
uncertainty: King 批评与 neo-Vedantin 标签均为该页转述层。

claim: 跋达罗衍那：《梵经》署名作者；亦称毗耶娑；'阇弥尼之师'为传统说法。
locator: Wikipedia Brahma Sutras：'The Brahma Sūtras or Brahmasutra are attributed to Badarayana. In some texts, Badarayana is also called Vyasa, which literally means "one who arranges".'；'Badarayana was the Guru (teacher) of Jaimini, the latter credited with authoring Mimamsa Sutras'
note: 站外人物；师承句为传统说法，与 I03 包阇弥尼条目相接，不采信为定论。
uncertainty: 年代三口径（维基区间/SEP 传承口径）已并陈。

claim: 乔荼波陀：《乔荼波陀颂》释《蛙氏奥义书》；6或7世纪；不二论前史关键；商羯罗注是其广注的一部分。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'According to tradition, Govinda's teacher was Gauḍapāda (sixth century CE), who composed the Gauḍapādakārikās (Verses of Gauḍapāda) on the Māṇḍūkya Upaniṣad. The historical record of Advaita Vedānta is obscure prior to Gauḍapāda'；'Śaṅkara's commentary on the Māṇḍukya is part of his extensive commentary on the Gauḍapādakārikās' explanation of the Māṇḍūkya.'；Wikipedia Vedanta：'Gaudapada (7th century)'
note: 站外人物。
uncertainty: 年代两口径并陈。

claim: 商羯罗（站内人物）：约8世纪（SEP）vs 9世纪（维基）；最早现存完整三始注释；《覆盖疏》《千教》；托名著作问题；māyāvādin 贬称。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'Śaṅkarācārya (hereafter Śaṅkara), who flourished during the eighth century CE'；'He composed our earliest complete extant commentaries...'；'Śaṅkara also composed an independent work titled the Upadeśasāhasrī (A Thousand Teachings).'；'hundreds of other texts attributed to Śaṅkara, but their authorship is questionable'；'labeled him a māyāvādin'；Wikipedia Vedanta：'Adi Shankara (9th century)'
note: 站内 philosophers.json 已有页：school='不二论吠檀多'，era='约7—8世纪（具体纪年有争议）'，sources 即 SEP shankara 与 IEP advaita-vedanta 两页——本包口径与其一致（并陈不裁决）。
uncertainty: 年代三口径并陈。

claim: 罗摩奴阇：限定不二论奠基者；两系年代；梵经与薄伽梵歌梵语注；bhakti；四异议。
locator: Wikipedia Ramanuja：'chief proponent of Vishishtadvaita school of Vedānta'；'Ramanuja himself wrote influential texts, such as Sanskrit bhāsyas on the Brahma Sutras and the Bhagavad Gita.'；'The Tradition dates his birth at 1017 and his death at 1137... modern era scholars suggest that Ramanuja may have lived between 1077–1157 CE'
note: 站外人物。
uncertainty: 生卒两系并陈（寿命120年 vs 80年）。

claim: 摩陀婆：Dvaita 首席阐述者；自称 Tattvavāda；两系年代；三十七部著作；《随释》；乌迪皮道场；批评商羯罗与罗摩奴阇；化身说遭 Mesquita 质疑。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya：'Madhvacharya (IAST: Madhvācārya; 1199–1278 CE or 1238–1317 CE), also known as Purna Prajna (Pūrṇa-Prajña) and Ānanda Tīrtha, was an Indian philosopher, theologian and the chief proponent of the Dvaita (dualism) school of Vedanta.'；'Madhva called his philosophy Tattvavāda meaning "arguments from a realist viewpoint".'；'wrote commentaries on the Principal Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita and the Brahma Sutras (Prasthanatrayi), and is credited with thirty seven works in Sanskrit'；'Madhvacharya was a critic of Adi Shankara's Advaita Vedanta and Ramanuja's Vishishtadvaita Vedanta teachings.'；'Madhva established the Krishna Mutt at Udupi with a murti secured from Dwarka Gujarat in 1285 CE.'
note: 站外人物。
uncertainty: 化身说文本依据：'a number of scriptural sources adduced by Madhva... are untraceable and were likely composed by Madhva himself'（Mesquita）——不作事实陈述。

claim: 维韦卡南达：新吠檀多推广者、西传推手；IEP 圣者名单；neo-Vedantin 标签含'拒绝世界为幻'立场。
locator: Wikipedia Vedanta：'A major proponent in the popularization of this Universalist and Perennialist interpretation of Advaita Vedanta was Vivekananda'；'Ramakrishna, Vivekananda and Aurobindo have been labeled neo-Vedantists..., a view of Vedanta that rejects the Advaitins' idea that the world is illusory.'（引 Gier）；IEP 圣者名单句（见 /school/overview/18）
note: 站外人物；未核读专页，不系生卒。
uncertainty: neo-Vedantin 标签与 Gier 评述为该页转述层。

claim: 跋达罗衍那—乔荼波陀之间无直接证据：仅传统追溯与史料不明。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'Advaita Vedāntins trace their lineage back through Bādarāyaṇa... By this lineage they claim the authority of Upaniṣadic teachers, Kṛṣṇa, and Bādarāyana as their own.'；'The historical record of Advaita Vedānta is obscure prior to Gauḍapāda'
note: 该 relation 是澄清性条目（不断言直接接触）。

claim: 乔荼波陀→商羯罗：师承传统与文本接受（广注）。
locator: SEP Śaṅkara：'According to tradition, Govinda's teacher was Gauḍapāda'；'Śaṅkara's commentary on the Māṇḍukya is part of his extensive commentary on the Gauḍapādakārikās'
note: 师承本身按'据传统'口径。

claim: 跋达罗衍那→商羯罗：现存最早完整《梵经》注释。
locator: SEP：'our earliest complete extant commentaries on the Brahmasūtras'；Wikipedia Brahma Sutras 注释清单句（见 /school/overview/7）

claim: 跋达罗衍那→罗摩奴阇：Śrī Bhāṣya 等经注。
locator: Wikipedia Ramanuja：'Sanskrit bhāsyas on the Brahma Sutras and the Bhagavad Gita'；Wikipedia Brahma Sutras 注释清单句列 Ramanuja

claim: 跋达罗衍那→摩陀婆：《梵经》注与《随释》。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya：'wrote commentaries on the Principal Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita and the Brahma Sutras (Prasthanatrayi)'；'His greatest work is considered to be the Anuvyakhyana, a philosophical supplement to his bhasya on the Brahma Sutras composed with a poetic structure.'；Wikipedia Brahma Sutras 注释清单句列 Madhvacharya

claim: 罗摩奴阇→商羯罗：四个主要异议与选择性解读指控。
locator: 见 /school/overview/15 两段 verbatim

claim: 摩陀婆→商羯罗：自称批评者；有神论二元论与一元论相左；SEP 对立传统句。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya：'Madhvacharya was a critic of Adi Shankara's Advaita Vedanta and Ramanuja's Vishishtadvaita Vedanta teachings.'；'His school's theistic dualism teachings disagreed with the monist teachings of the other two most influential schools of Vedanta based on Advaita's nondualism and Vishishtadvaita's qualified nondualism.'；SEP rival traditions 句（见 /school/overview/16）

claim: 维韦卡南达→商羯罗：普遍主义化接受与西传；立场含'拒绝世界为幻'，非复述。

locator: Wikipedia Brahma Sutras 年代学句（见 /school/overview/4）；SEP 'ca. first century BCE' 句（见 /school/overview/6）
note: 两口径并陈。

uncertainty: 'probably' 层判断。

locator: SEP 'Gauḍapāda (sixth century CE)'；Wikipedia Vedanta 'Gaudapada (7th century)'

claim: 约8世纪商羯罗三始注释。

note: 维基另作9世纪已声明。

claim: 11—12世纪罗摩奴阇与限定不二论建制。

claim: 吠檀多词义与'传统群'定性。

claim: 三始名目与'诸师皆作三注'。

claim: 我：从同一到永异的光谱。
locator: SEP 'numerically identical with brahman'；Wikipedia Vedanta 'a difference that is never transcended'；Wikipedia Madhvacharya 'never identical'

locator: SEP māyāvādin 段；IEP metaphysics 段（见 /school/overview/14）；Wikipedia Vedanta 引 Gier：'Ramakrishna, Vivekananda and Aurobindo have been labeled neo-Vedantists..., a view of Vedanta that rejects the Advaitins' idea that the world is illusory.'
